lines.zh: 我踩着水晶走，脚感很凉。
lines.en: I walk on crystal; it is cool underfoot.
The two stones on my back knock together.
The allurite side weighs a little more.
The canyon echoes lead my way.

lines.zh: 我走得很慢，怕碰掉晶体。
lines.en: I walk slowly so the crystals stay put.
Rings of light ripple beneath my feet.
I step around the sharp crystal clusters.

lines.zh: 身体贴地，尾巴扫着石屑。
lines.en: Belly low, my tail sweeps the stone chips.
I know the light of this canyon.

lines.zh: 背上的石头又长了一点。
lines.en: The stones on my back grew a little more.
Water glares; I tread carefully.

lines.zh: 我的脚印在晶面上发亮。
lines.en: My tracks glow on the crystal floor.
Head to the spring; it is warmer there.

lines.zh: 别催，我背着水晶走不快。
lines.en: Do not rush me; carrying crystals, I walk slow.

lines.zh: 我踩过一片粉盐，脚下发软。
lines.en: I cross a patch of pink salt and my feet sink.
I shuffle along the crystal clusters' shadows.
I lie still and let the crystals grow.
The allurite chitters on my back.

lines.zh: 流光石发热，我晒一会儿。
lines.en: The lumiere warms; I bask a while.
The blue reflects on the wall, lovely.
I count the facets of the crystals.
The canyon is so calm I feel drowsy.
My belly rests against cold stone.
I lay my head at the edge of a rock.
The light on my body brightens and dims.
A grain of sand falls into my gills.

lines.zh: 我在等石头长成完整的一颗。
lines.en: I wait for the stone to grow whole.

lines.zh: 这里的味道像雨后的石壁。
lines.en: This smells like stone walls after rain.
My tail curls around and covers my nose.

lines.zh: 我眨了眨眼，光抖了一下。
lines.en: I blink and the light trembles.

lines.zh: 我把背贴到洞壁上凉一凉。
lines.en: I press my back to the cave wall to cool.

lines.zh: 有一颗晶体今天长歪了。
lines.en: One crystal grew crooked today.
You stepped on my crystal.

lines.zh: 你手上有没有亮的东西？
lines.en: Do you have anything bright in hand?

lines.zh: 仰头看你，我的腮都张开了。
lines.en: Looking up at you, my gills open wide.
Your shadow blocks my light.
You came for crystals, did you not?
The stones on my back are not for sale.
There is blue light in your eyes.
Come closer, but do not touch that one.

lines.zh: 我在峡谷里没见过你这身。
lines.en: I have not seen that outfit in this canyon.
Your breathing sounds unfamiliar.
Crystal dust clings to your boots.
Not so fast; my reflexes are slow.
A crack opened in my crystal.
Not the back; that is the fragile part.

lines.zh: 我一缩，背上的光就灭了。
lines.en: I curl up and the light on my back dies.
Stone dust got in the wound; it stings.
I shed a small piece of allurite.

lines.zh: 你下手真重，晶体都歪了。
lines.en: You hit hard; my crystals are crooked.
I shrink deeper into the crystal cluster.

lines.zh: 这一下，我半天没缓过来。
lines.en: That one left me dazed for a while.
My tail is trembling.

lines.zh: 别再来一下，我背不动了。
lines.en: Not another; I cannot carry more.
That stone is too bright.
Wave it once and I will follow.
Is that allurite? Let me see it.

lines.zh: 我背上的晶体在朝它响。
lines.en: The crystals on my back ring toward it.
I know that shade of blue.

lines.zh: 流光石的碎片，你从哪捡的？
lines.en: Where did you find that lumiere shard?
I cannot help drifting over.
The closer the light, the weaker my steps.

lines.zh: 你的手里像有一小片峡谷。
lines.en: Your hand holds a little piece of canyon.
May I trade you some moss for it?
Hold it up longer; let me look my fill.
That glow makes my gills itch.
Three steps, a pause, another look.
Slow down; I am chasing the shine.
The light in your hand is brighter than mine.

lines.zh: 那是峡谷里掉下来的吗？
lines.en: Did that fall from the canyon floor?

lines.zh: 我一软，你的膝盖撞到我背。
lines.en: I am soft; your knee hits my back.
Do not bump me; crystals are fragile.
You are on my tail.

lines.zh: 我们挤在一起，蓝光叠成一片。
lines.en: We crowd together; blue light merges.
My body is like wet cloth.

lines.zh: 你退一步，我身上的石粉落了。
lines.en: Step back; stone dust falls off me.
Did that hurt you? It hurt me too.
I walked too close and did not notice.
Stone met stone with a single note.

lines.zh: 你挡住了我的路，我绕过去。
lines.en: You blocked my path; I go around.

lines.zh: 峡谷的水声变了，我知道季节。
lines.en: The water's sound changed; I know the season.
I brighten my light for a mate.

lines.zh: 背上两颗石头，是最好的礼物。
lines.en: Two stones on my back make the best gift.
Approach slowly; do not startle her.

lines.zh: 两只螈在石上并排趴着。
lines.en: Two salamanders lie side by side on the stone.
Our lights have matched.
At times like this, the canyon is quietest.
I will guard these eggs.

lines.zh: 蓝光缠在一起，分不清谁是谁。
lines.en: Blue lights tangle; I cannot tell whose is whose.

lines.zh: 她会喜欢我这块流光石。
lines.en: She will like my lumiere stone.
My mouth is short; I cannot hold things.

lines.zh: 那枚碎片滚到石缝里了。
lines.en: The shard rolled into a crack.
I try my tongue; it will not lift.
You pick it up; I will watch.
My front claws are too soft.

lines.zh: 亮晶晶的东西掉地上，可惜。
lines.en: Something shiny fell; a pity.
Moss is all I can carry.
Into the water it goes, sinking.
I nudged it and it did not move.

lines.zh: 那不是我掉的，是我的光引来的。
lines.en: That is not mine; my light drew it.

lines.zh: 你踩碎了晶体，我生气了。
lines.en: You crushed a crystal; now I am cross.
I normally do not chase anyone.

lines.zh: 你的手离我的晶体太近。
lines.en: Your hand is too near my crystals.

lines.zh: 我弓起背，晶体全竖起来。
lines.en: I arch my back and every crystal stands up.
Go away; this time I will not hide.
That is my burrow; do not dig it.

lines.zh: 你吓到我了，我要顶你一下。
lines.en: You frightened me; I will butt you once.

lines.zh: 峡谷里没有别的地方可退。
lines.en: There is nowhere else to retreat in this canyon.
I have fixed on your boot heel.
Just this once, I will not yield.
Head low, I shuffle toward you.

lines.zh: 光暗下去，就是我最后的提醒。
lines.en: Dimming light is my final warning.
Reach the water and I stop chasing.
I point my crystals at you.

lines.zh: 那块蓝石，是我长出来的。
lines.en: That blue stone grew out of me.
I circle you, looking for a gap.
My tail slaps the ground, beat by beat.
You move; I answer.
I do not want to fight, but stop digging.
The light is gathering; you can see it.
I butt you, crystals first.
My tail sweeps through with stone dust.
Do not blame me; you stepped first.

lines.zh: 这一下，我自己的石头也掉了。
lines.en: That hit knocked off one of my own stones.

lines.zh: 我咬住你的裤脚，往后拖。
lines.en: I bite your trouser leg and pull back.

lines.zh: 蓝光一闪，我撞上你的膝。
lines.en: Blue flashes; I strike your knee.

lines.zh: 我的力气不大，可石头硬。
lines.en: I am not strong, but the stones are hard.
You backed off; that is enough.
A crystal scraped your hand.
I strike and run, though I run slow.
I poke my head from behind a crystal cluster.

lines.zh: 光从石缝里漏下来，我醒了。
lines.en: Light leaks through the crack; I wake.
The canyon is quiet today.
The stones on my back are still small.

lines.zh: 有人在挖石头，我听见了。
lines.en: Someone is mining; I hear it.
I was born in this blue glow.
Water sounds from deep below.
I licked the stone wall first.

lines.zh: 这片峡谷只养得起几只螈。
lines.en: This canyon only feeds a few of us.

lines.zh: 我的第一颗晶体长出来了。
lines.en: My first crystal has grown in.

lines.zh: 火烤着我的晶体，味道很怪。
lines.en: Fire heats my crystals; the smell is strange.
I fall and a crystal corner chips off.

lines.zh: 水里我能待，可晶体进了水。
lines.en: I can stay underwater, but water got into the crystal.

lines.zh: 炸得我翻了个身，光乱闪。
lines.en: The blast flips me over; my light flickers wild.
An arrow grazes the crystal with a ding.
Magic passes through me like cold water.

lines.zh: 苔藓吃完了，我的光变弱。
lines.en: The moss is gone; my light grows weak.
Thunder sets every crystal ringing.

lines.zh: 我掉出世界，光看不见了。
lines.en: I fall out of the world; my light is gone.
